properties.Title: Canada 150 Mosaic
properties.Description: This mural was painted by members of the public and was part of a series of murals. The subject of each mural across the country is unique to the specific community and is placed on train tracks or a train car, which visually connects each piece.
properties.ProjectInitiative: Part of a series of murals spanning the country to celebrate Canada’s 150th anniversary. The Theme was “What makes Canada special to me”.
